reason: The shared-context pitch fits how I work — I run three agents and hate context silos — but I never buy a dev tool without checking Reddit, GitHub issues, and Twitter first, and there's nothing to check yet. Handing a brand-new local daemon my credentials across every agent at $30/seat before anyone I trust has vetted it is a no.
objection: No track record — no Reddit threads, GitHub issues, or Twitter takes to vet, and I'd be giving a brand-new local daemon access to every agent's credentials and context at once.
would_change_my_mind: Real user reviews from teams like mine, plus a way to try it without handing over all my credentials to a new daemon.
